column1: # Dictation corrections for Speech Note, compiled by
# KEEP THIS LIST SMALL. Speech Note corrupts long rule lists: writing 28 rules
# verified fine and survived three restarts, but opening the Rules page in the
# GUI left 7 intact and 9 replaced by empty entries. The corruption is not
# pattern-specific - BUSCO was emptied while the near-identical LIBS survived.
# Around a dozen rules has proven stable. Prefer terms that are misheard often
# and matter; a better STT model fixes more than a long rule list does.
